svg.aria-label: One SMT-LIB query is sent to both Z3 and cvc5 and each reply is classified. The pair is an agreement only when both are conclusive, equal and any witness model is verified; otherwise it is a disagreement, unavailable or inconclusive. The CLI exits 0 or 1 on an agreement and 3 on anything else.
